recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-18161 unless the work group wants a new, separate enhancement for an RxNorm-oriented or richer drug-specific supplement example.
issue_request: FHIR-18161 was a Published/Persuasive vocab change request for STU3 asking for an example that clarifies how a CodeSystem supplement would provide supplemental information for an existing code. The resolution agreed to add an example but explicitly did not require an RxNorm-specific example.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites git 66ae1e40f1bc02283363c872db14035fc795f8f7, which added source/codesystem/codesystem-example-supplement.xml as a CodeSystem with content='supplement', supplements='http://hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/example', a supplemental boolean property, and property values for existing concepts.
additional_context: CodeSystem is active in source/fhir.ini and source/codesystem/list-CodeSystem-examples.xml includes CodeSystem/example-supplement. Later related vocab issues FHIR-27745 and FHIR-38675 added a language-translation supplement example and a ValueSet example that uses a supplement property; FHIR-39052 clarified a ValueSet supplement extension by linking to the CodeSystem supplement section. These later decisions complement rather than reverse the FHIR-18161 application. FHIR-18161-specific Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current CodeSystem supplement example demonstrates the requested supplement mechanics, remains in current build scope, and the original issue did not require an RxNorm-specific model.
